name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (architect → explore → design) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (direct Sonnet worker dispatch per layer wave, executed red-check) → /spec:review (deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape. Changelog (last 3): 7.2.0 — ledger truth: verdict.js counts findings-leg findings (parsed, floored at 1 per red row) into the undispositioned pool so CLEAN is unreachable while a red leg sits undispositioned, and the disposition-contradiction guard widens to match; ledger leg rows retain their `observed` string in both profiles; review ledger rows always carry a generated-or-passed `runId`; build.md's `deviations`/`diff.loc` ledger definitions corrected to match what verdict.js and review actually count. 7.1.0 — promise-sweep leg: new deterministic promise-sweep.js enumerates every spec Decisions row and hard-flags any lacking a same-spec AC-ID carrier or [no-ac:] sanction (advisory at plan lock, required-but-non-blocking in every review scope via review-legs.js/verdict.js); reviewer.md's promise sweep shrinks to the semantic half; core.md § Tiers rules critical tier adds review capacity only as scoped named legs, never a second general reviewer. 7.0.0 — ground-up redesign: workflow codegen seam, panel/verifier split, sanctioned-red baseline, scaffold/claims/parity/hotspot/observe/intake guard bookkeeping and all prose-regex pin tests retired; doctrine consolidated into core.md (+ design.md carried verbatim); incident policy = fix + behavioral test same session, deterministic guard only on third recurrence; tier standard/critical; gates plainly green.
